mapper.select: SELECT credential_id, merchant_id, credential_type, secret_hash, secret_hint, status, created_at, rotated_at, revoked_at FROM merchant_credential WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT credential_id, merchant_id, secret_ciphertext, CAST(ip_allowlist AS CHAR) AS ip_allowlist, expires_at FROM merchant_credential WHERE credential_id = #{credentialId} AND credential_type = 'API' AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND secret_ciphertext IS NOT NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > #{now})

SELECT credential_id, merchant_id, secret_ciphertext, CAST(ip_allowlist AS CHAR) AS ip_allowlist, expires_at FROM merchant_credential WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND credential_type = #{credentialType} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND secret_ciphertext IS NOT NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > #{now}) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_api_nonce (merchant_id, credential_id, nonce, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{merchantId}, #{credentialId}, #{nonce}, #{expiresAt}, #{now})

INSERT INTO merchant_credential (credential_id, merchant_id, credential_type, secret_hash, secret_ciphertext, secret_hint, expires_at, ip_allowlist, status, created_at) VALUES (#{credentialId}, #{merchantId}, #{credentialType}, #{secretHash}, #{secretCiphertext}, #{secretHint}, #{expiresAt}, #{ipAllowlist}, 'ACTIVE', #{now})
